Property.Name: mipi-sdca-entity-type
Property.Description: This property describes entity type. Encoding is defined in the SDCA Specification, Table entitled Enumeration Values for DisCo Property: mipi-sdca-entity-type.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-entity-label
Property.Description: This property contains the label corresponding with the entity label shown in the SDCA topology diagram for the audio function. E.g. “OT12”, “XU99”

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-control-list
Property.Description: An integer containing one bit for each control selector present in this entity. Bit 0 maps to control selector 0, bit 18 maps to control selector 18, etc.

Package.Name: Sdca_ControlSelector
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to a package describing properties for each control selector. n is encoded as a hexadecimal integer. n equals to each bit that bit that is set in mipi-sdca-control-selector-list, encoded as a capitalized hex number without any leading zeros (i.e. %X not %8X or %8x). See Table 19 Control Descriptor for package contents.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-input-pin-list
Property.Description: This property describes the connected input pins for this Entity. Bin N is set to indicate a connection on pin N. Bit 0 is always 0.

Package.Name: Sdca_Entity
Package.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to the Entity Descriptor package connected to pin n. n is encoded as a decimal integer (with no leading zeros), for each non-zero bit in mipi-sdca-input-pin-list. For a Clock Selector (CX), this is either a Clock Source or another Clock Selector.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-type
Property.Description: This property describes the terminal type as described in SDCA specification in the tables entitled Enumeration Values for DisCo Property mipi-sdca-terminal-type.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-reference-number
Property.Description: An integer representing jack number to which this IT/OT is connected. This property shall only be used when the terminal is connected to a jack input (see SDCA spec for details).

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-connector-type
Property.Description: An integer representing connector type to which this IT/OT is connected. This property shall only be used when the terminal has a connector as described in SDCA specification in the tables entitled TODO:Add reference here.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-cs-type
Property.Description: This property indicates whether the Clock Source is synchronous or asynchronous to the bus clock.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-clock-valid-max-delay
Property.Description: This property reports the maximum delay that software needs to wait for clock to be valid.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-powerdomain-managed-list
mipi-sdca-powerdomain-transition-typical-delay
Property.Description: This property describes typical time it takes to transition from one power state to another. The Package has triplets of integers in the form of From_PS, To_PS, Time(us). e.g. Package() { 3, 0, 350 , 0, 3, 50, 2, 0, 150, 0, 2, 50 }

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-powerdomain-transition-max-delay
Property.Description: This property describes the maximum time it takes to transition from one power state to another. The Package has triplets of integers in the form of From_PS, To_PS, Time(us). e.g. Package() { 3, 0, 500, 0, 3, 200, 2, 0, 500, 0, 2, 200 }

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-ge-managed-terminal-reference-number
Property.Description: This property maps to the value contained in the mipi-sdca-terminal-reference-number within an IT or OT Entity Descriptor.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-tone-nominal-frequency
Property.Description: This property specifies the base frequency for the tone generator.

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-HIDTx-supported-report-ids
Property.Description: A package containing one integer entry for each report id transmitted by this HIDE Tx. e.g. {1, 2, 5}

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-HIDRx-supported-report-ids
Property.Description: A package containing one integer entry for each report id transmitted by this HIDE Rx. e.g. {1, 2, 5}

Property.Name: mipi-sdca-hide-related-audio-function-list
Property.Description: A package containing one integer entry for each audio function number within this device that is sending/receiving the messages in this HIDE.

HierarchicalProperty.Name: mipi-sdca-terminal-clock-connection
HierarchicalProperty.Description: String encoding of a NameString of an object resolving to the Entity Descriptor package for the clock entity (either a Clock Source or a Clock Selector) that directly supplies the clock to this terminal. This property is required if a clock input pin connection is present.
